banner.show: Show disclaimer: decision support, not legal advice

landing.title: Read your contract the way you read the skyline
landing.palmBody: Drop in the sale and purchase agreement. Every term is pulled out with its page number and the exact words it came from.
landing.skyTitle: From the dunes to the skyline, one contract at a time

extraction.title: Extraction
extraction.body: Key terms with the page and the exact quote. If the contract does not say it, we show “not stated”, never a guess.

penalty.title: Delay-penalty simulator
penalty.body: Exact arithmetic in plain code, from the contract's own grace period, rate and cap.

cashflow.title: Cash-flow
cashflow.body: Payments by month or quarter, and how much is tied to construction and handover.

assistant.title: Buyer assistant
assistant.body: Answers only from your contract, cites the clause, and refers legal questions to the legal team.

cross.title: Cross-document check
cross.body: Compare the SPA with related documents.

bilingual.title: Arabic–English check
bilingual.body: Spot differences between the two language versions.

rulebook.title: Rulebook check
rulebook.body: Check terms against the jurisdiction rules.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp assistant
whatsapp.body: Ask your contract questions in a chat.

evalset.title: Real evaluation set
evalset.body: Accuracy measured on real, labelled contracts.

landing.ctaBody: Open the app, pick a sample, or upload your own PDF.

shell.dropTitle: Drop a PDF here, or choose a file
shell.pickBody: Choose a sample on the left or upload your own SPA.
shell.serverDownBody: Start the API (uvicorn backend.api.main:app) and reload.
shell.notExtractedTitle: This contract has not been read yet
shell.extractCost: Extraction uses 1 LLM call (2 if the first answer fails validation). The result is cached.
shell.notConfigured: The model is not configured on the server. Add the settings to .env.
shell.scanned: This PDF looks scanned (almost no extractable text). Scanned documents are not supported yet.

terms.title: Extracted terms
terms.noWarnings: No warnings: the payment plan totals 100% and every quote was found in the PDF.

basis.fixed_per_sqft_per_year: Fixed amount per sq ft per year

penalty.title: Delay-penalty simulator
penalty.intro: Compensation accrues only on days after the grace period. All arithmetic runs on the server in plain code, using the terms below.
penalty.dialHelp: Drag the dial, use the arrow keys, or pick a preset.
penalty.capReached: The cap is reached: compensation stops growing.

cashflow.title: Cash-flow
cashflow.unscheduled: Not placed on the timeline (no due date stated)
cashflow.mismatch: The plan totals {{plan}} but the purchase price is {{price}}.

chat.title: Buyer assistant
chat.intro: Answers come only from this contract's extracted terms and cite the clause. Legal questions go to the legal team.
chat.placeholder: Ask about payments, handover or the late-fee rule…
chat.s2: What happens if the developer is late?
chat.s5: Can I cancel and get a refund?

accuracy.title: Extraction accuracy
accuracy.needConfirm: Some samples are not cached, so running will call the model. Confirm to continue.
accuracy.mismatchModel: These results were produced with {{old}}, not the current {{current}}.

badge.unreviewedHelp: This result depends on a rule from a jurisdiction pack that no lawyer has reviewed. Treat it as decision support only.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.confidenceHelp: Confidence = weighted mean of the checks that apply: quote found on the page, values appear in the quote, names appear in the document.
evidence.highlighted: The exact span is highlighted on the page.
evidence.noBox: No exact position found for this text; showing the page.

gap.title: Contract vs statute
gap.intro: Compares the delay compensation in the contract with what the jurisdiction pack's statutory formula gives, for a delay scenario. Every input is listed below with its source.
gap.barsLabel: Bars comparing the contractual and the statutory amount
gap.illustrative: The rate table in use is ILLUSTRATIVE test data, not real rates. Edit rules/rates/ before relying on any figure.
gap.oneSided: The contract is less favourable than the statute in this scenario.
gap.notOneSided: The contract is at least as favourable as the statute in this scenario.

mc.title: Probabilistic view
mc.disclaimer: The delay distribution below is YOUR assumption, not a prediction. No machine-learning delay forecast is used; every amount comes from the same tested calculators as the deterministic view.
mc.signalShift: progress signal shifts delays by {{d}} days

obl.intro: Dated obligations derived from each contract, with the evidence for each date. Alerts are shown in this app only; nothing is sent by email, WhatsApp or SMS.
obl.noneBody: No dated obligations match these filters.

playbook.title: Playbook check
playbook.example: Example playbook: all thresholds and clauses are fictional placeholders (example, replace with company-approved text).
playbook.internal: Internal view. Not shown to buyers.
playbook.noApproved: No approved clause exists: flag for legal.
playbook.llmCost: Qualitative rules need one LLM call for this contract (cached afterwards).

erp.title: ERP export (D365 F&O)
erp.placeholder: Entity and field names in the mapping are PLACEHOLDERS. Confirm them in your D365 environment (erp/d365_mapping.yaml) before any live push.
erp.exposureHelp: Statutory exposure rows depend on unreviewed legal logic.
erp.pushDisabled: Live push is disabled (ERP_PUSH_ENABLED is not set). Dry-run files above are always available.
erp.confirmBody: This will send {{n}} rows to the configured D365 environment and write an audit-log entry.
erp.confirmCheck: I confirm the mapping has been checked

review.title: Review queue
review.intro: Fields the system is not sure about. Accept, correct or reject each one; your decision overrides the extraction and is stored with your name and the time.
review.emptyBody: Every extracted field is grounded or already reviewed.
review.goldenHelp: Writes eval/golden/<doc>/ with human-verified labels (fields still unreviewed are listed in the file).

cross.title: Cross-document check
cross.intro: The same unit appears in several documents. Differences in price, area, dates, payment plan, penalty terms or registration number are flagged with evidence from both documents.
cross.syntheticNote: Synthetic demo set with planted mismatches. It shows how the check works; it is not real data.
cross.noneBody: Add a set under samples/crossdoc or create one through the API.
cross.score: Planted-error check: precision {{p}}, recall {{r}} ({{tp}} of {{n}} found)
cross.noConflicts: No conflicts found among the documents read.

acc2.noReal: No real documents yet: these numbers say nothing about accuracy on real contracts.
acc2.cachedOnly: No model key configured: cached extractions only.
acc2.emptyBody: Press “Run eval” (or run python eval/run_eval.py) to create the first run.
acc2.stub: test stub, not a real model
acc2.stubNote: This run used the test-only stub model, so its numbers describe the pipeline, not a real model.
acc2.tableMetric: Payment-plan rows F1 {{f1}}; percentage sum correct in {{ok}} of {{docs}} documents.
acc2.costNote: Cost = real token or page usage × the price constants you set in rules/pricing.yaml; shown as n/a until they are set.

auth.signInBody: This app is limited to approved users. Sign in with your GitHub account; the owner decides who is allowed and with which role.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured on this server. Ask the owner.
